# Frankie 1.1.22
- Makes Computer Run completion durable across restarts, offline periods, and account switches. - Prevents queued runs, stop/steer controls, and chat continuations from targeting or overwriting the wrong work. - Preserves up to 200 verified records with explicit truncation and incomplete-run reporting. - Shows Computer Run progress and completion live in the open Frankie conversation. - Clarifies that foreground Mac control owns the screen, mouse, and keyboard while it runs.
Ask Frankie source: `e370d461bf3a056708309f2e60bb832cafd4386f`
